units: Per 100 g as eaten (per 100 ml for drinks). Typical values; recipes vary.

sources.protein: Protein-Sources.pdf for the items marked proteinSource (midpoint of each range).
sources.other: Indian Food Composition Tables (IFCT 2017)-style typical values and standard home recipes.

foods.name: Poli / chapati
foods.notes: Whole-wheat flatbread with a little oil.

foods.name: Jowar bhakri
foods.notes: About 80 % flour by weight; jowar protein from Protein-Sources.pdf.

foods.name: Bajra bhakri
foods.notes: About 80 % flour by weight; bajra protein from Protein-Sources.pdf.

foods.name: Varan (plain toor dal)
foods.notes: Derived from toor dal in Protein-Sources.pdf (dry weight x 2.8 cooked).

foods.name: Varan bhaat with ghee
foods.notes: Rice 150 g + varan 100 g + 1 tsp ghee.

foods.name: Moong dal (cooked)
foods.notes: Derived from moong dal in Protein-Sources.pdf (dry weight x 2.8 cooked).

foods.name: Masoor dal tadka
foods.notes: Protein based on masoor dal in Protein-Sources.pdf.

foods.name: Soya chunk curry
foods.notes: Protein based on soya chunks in Protein-Sources.pdf.

foods.name: Tofu bhurji
foods.notes: Protein based on tofu in Protein-Sources.pdf.

foods.name: Coffee
aliases: coffee with buffalo milk no sugar
foods.notes: 5 g coffee powder dissolved in 1 tbsp water, topped with Chitale buffalo milk. Set the milk each time.

foods.name: English cucumber (raw)
foods.notes: Raw, with peel. A whole English cucumber is about 300 g.

foods.name: Dragon fruit (white flesh)
foods.notes: Flesh only. A medium fruit has about 300 g of flesh.

foods.name: Coffee powder (instant / brew)
foods.notes: Dissolved powder (USDA instant coffee). About 18 kcal in 5 g.

foods.name: Egg white
foods.notes: 1 large egg white ≈ 3.6 g protein, almost no fat.

foods.name: Egg half fry (sunny side up)
foods.notes: 1 egg fried in ½ tsp oil; set the eggs and oil when logging.

foods.name: Egg full fry (over hard)
foods.notes: 1 egg fried in ½ tsp oil; set the eggs and oil when logging.

foods.name: Buffalo milk (Chitale)
foods.notes: Chitale full cream (buffalo) milk, per 100 ml. Protein-Sources.pdf said 4–4.5 g protein.

foods.name: Soya chunks (boiled)
foods.notes: Boiled and squeezed, as added to dishes. Dry values from Protein-Sources.pdf ÷ 3 (25 g dry ≈ 75 g boiled).

foods.name: Toor dal (dry)
foods.notes: Dry weight; cooked dal is lower per 100 g (see Varan).

foods.name: Moong, whole (dry, for sprouts)
foods.notes: Dry seed. PDF: moong sprouts ~24 g on dry weight; cooked lower.

foods.name: Moong sprouts (ready to eat)
foods.notes: Derived: dry seed ≈ 2.5× weight after sprouting.

foods.name: Matki sprouts (ready to eat)
foods.notes: Derived: dry seed ≈ 2.5× weight after sprouting.

foods.name: Seeds & nuts mix
foods.notes: Per meal: 5 g each pumpkin, sunflower and watermelon seeds, almonds and cashews; 4 g walnuts; 1 g pista. Adjust the amounts when you log it.

foods.name: Mixed vegetables (raw)
foods.notes: Carrot, beans, peas and capsicum, as added to pulao, upma or poha.
